<!-- pr-reviewer: 54a8346e55526221f3d5882291f87e0fa66cab03 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge after the author marks this draft ready. No blocking findings.

I read the full diff and checked it against the current upstream `AGENTS.md`.
The change names the stock in each empty-result refusal and gives the model source choices.
A model source keeps the previous refusal text. The change does not alter successful detection or operation state.
The new module reads the document through the ECS world. It includes its provenance and a decision record.

Local results

I tested the trial merge in `.claude/worktrees/review-3923`.
The merge has these parents:

- PR head: `54a8346e55526221f3d5882291f87e0fa66cab03` (`HEAD^1`).
- Upstream main: `b13ebd440df1c1e422325b02a07df2c639ca5d68` (`HEAD^2`).

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | PASS: 343 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. Includes app and selected UI builds. |
| New stock-source MCP regression test | PASS. Checks no model, two models, and a model source. |
| App `mcp` suite | PASS: 49 tests. |
| App `thread_boss` suite | PASS: 12 tests. |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | PASS: 6 steps, 11 light tests, 0 failed, 0 stalled. |
| `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS. |
| `git diff --check upstream/main` | PASS. |

Extra suites run

The quick gate ran these catalog suites by name:

- `example_catalog`: 41 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed, 0 failed.

The `plunge_depth_tab` suite also passed. The failure reported in the PR body does not occur with this upstream main.
No fixture or importer changed, so the extra fixture and kernel importer suites do not apply.

Safety and evidence

This PR changes refusal text. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation.
Safety mutations: not required; none run.
Goldens moved: none. No recorded program changed.
No `crates/ui` source changed, so before/after screenshots are not required.
No dependency, build script, workflow, or process file changed.
No full heavy lane ran, as required by the current review rules.

Requested before merge: none.
I left the labels, title, and draft state unchanged, as requested for this review.
The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build cache.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Please mark this draft ready with `gh pr ready 3923 -R NeoTech/Camcraft` so it can merge on this review.
